description: Use this when the user asks about one player's season or recent form ('Tatum stats', 'how is Bridges playing lately'). Returns season averages, efficiency (NBA: TS%, eFG%, USG%, BPM; NFL: yards, touchdowns, EPA), Keel Impact with its rank, current injury status and the last ten games. Not for on/off or teammate splits (player_splits_and_on_off) or prop lines (props_research).

player_id.description: Numeric player ID from the search tool.

season.description: Optional season year (e.g. 2026 for 2025-26 NBA or 2025 NFL). Defaults to the current season.
